items.summary: One public roadmap across the repos, built from approved issues with no dates.
One page listing accepted research questions across the public repos, with links to ask or help.
Render avd-assess methods, claims and sources like a paper with numbered citations and dispute links.
Add contract C26 (avd-cloud-environments/v1), sovereign pins, and GCC High checks to avd-assess.
Add -Cloud usgov support to the current-state collector, validator and assessment portal.
Orchestrate Azure US Government and GCC High deployments across the five control planes.
Add C26 cloud registry, sovereign workload placement rules and lessons to the second brain.

avd-current-state.status: Read-only PowerShell collector, validator, and redacted C11 facts snapshot across all five control planes.
avd-current-state.backlog: Add -Cloud usgov support (C26), signed collector release, and unified endpoint probe map.

avd-assess.status: Open AVD assessment methodology across five control planes, pinned sources, and C25/C26 contracts.
avd-assess.backlog: Expand GCC High checks (C26), benchmark corpus coverage, and sovereign pin verification.

avd-migrate.status: Offline single-pool C14 baseline designer and manifest writer portal at avd-ops.app/migrate/.
avd-migrate.backlog: Optional LZA .bicepparam starter export and multi-pool migration planning.

avd-benchmark.status: Tier 1 synthetic benchmark harness (storage, logon storm, density, autoscale, BCDR) and C25 explorer.
avd-benchmark.backlog: FlaUI workload engine, automated Tier 1 run evidence, and expanded explorer comparisons.

avd-learn.status: Ground-up AVD foundations dataset, CLI, and installable PWA mapped to AZ-104 and AZ-140.
avd-learn.backlog: Expand interactive lab scenarios, AZ-140 study modules, and cross-links to avd-ops standards.

avd-landing-zone.status: Top-level orchestrator and deployment portal at avd-ops.app/deploy/ across the control-plane repos.
avd-landing-zone.backlog: Azure US Government & GCC High orchestration (C26), autoscale power-role validation, and Private Link NSG guards.

avd-hcl.status: Enterprise IaC path for native AVD infrastructure alongside the Bicep orchestrator.
avd-hcl.backlog: Align module outputs with shared contracts and add end-to-end lab validation.

avd-entra.status: Declarative Microsoft Graph templates and Cloud Shell scripts for AVD groups, Conditional Access, and Entra Kerberos.
avd-entra.backlog: Validate greenfield and brownfield Entra Kerberos flows and sovereign cloud endpoints.

avd-intune.status: Intune policy-as-code, assignment filters, session-host MDM enrollment, and Windows 365 Cloud PC profiles.
avd-intune.backlog: Expand baseline policy packs, drift detection, and Windows 365 Cloud PC parity.

avd-m365.status: Greenfield Microsoft 365, OneDrive Known Folder Move, and Teams VDI optimization control plane.
avd-m365.backlog: Add Teams VDI optimization verification and automated M365 tenant readiness checks.

avd-azure.status: Cloud-native Azure Bicep engine for AVD host pools, workspaces, FSLogix Azure Files, and Private Link.
avd-azure.backlog: Sovereign cloud parameters, GPU session host SKU templates, and nested Azure Local lab support.

avd-networking.status: Platform Connectivity hub VNet, Azure Firewall, central Private DNS, DNS Private Resolver, gateways, and Bastion.
avd-networking.backlog: AVD Private Link NSG port rules, hub-peered bypass routes, and multi-region hub templates.

avd-power-platform.status: Power Platform governance, DLP policies, and approval-gated Power Automate day-2 workflows.
avd-power-platform.backlog: Expand self-service access flows and day-2 host lifecycle automation.

avd-remediate.status: 5-step guided troubleshooting portal, read-only diagnostic probes, and human-gated remediation workbench.
avd-remediate.backlog: Expand host telemetry collectors, BYO-LLM diagnostic adapters, and remediation runbooks.

avd-linecheck.status: End-user browser network check portal at avd-ops.app/linecheck/ measuring latency and endpoint reachability.
avd-linecheck.backlog: Companion local log-bundle script and unified probe map shared with avd-current-state.

avd-swarm.status: Desktop DevOps agents across AVD, Windows 365, and Intune; S1a spike runs with human-gated write design.
avd-swarm.backlog: Wire external executor plumbing, approval gates, and helpdesk ticket adapter (ADR 0027).

avd-second-brain.status: Desktop DevOps knowledge base, contract registry, and cross-repo docs consistency checks.
avd-second-brain.backlog: Add C26 cloud registry, sovereign workload placement rules, and automated freshness sweeps.

avd-ops.status: Front-door site (avd-ops.dev), standards library, security review, architecture diagrams, and onboarding docs.
avd-ops.backlog: Automated issue-board sync, operator walkthroughs, and cross-repo roadmap coverage.
